notes_for_editor: Thin record: only two lookout listings (Tennessee Landforms, Forest Lookouts) give anything about this tower, and they agree on removed, Haywood County, District 8 and 368 ft. No build date, design, staffing, fire, removal date or site description was found in two searches and four page reads. The Wikipedia page covers only the community. The brief's access 'unknown' is left out of facts. Brief elevation_m 112.2 matches 368 ft. Worth checking Haywood County or Brownsville newspaper archives and TDF records before publishing a fuller history. Note that the MPS dates TDF tower building to about 1930 to 1970, which does not establish a date for this tower.
